messages:
anna (Product): Quick sync — we need a compact plan for routing tiers and isolation for Q3. Customer asks coming in for both stricter isolation and lower latency paths.

mike (Arch): Agree. Proposal sketch: three routing tiers — reserved, shared-priority, best-effort. Each tier maps to isolation and region constraints.

julia (Customer Success): FYI: two enterprise customers want dedicated lanes + regional pinning (eu only) for compliance. One mid-market wants cheaper best-effort to lower cost.

sam (SRE): Danger: adding more tiers increases scheduling complexity and SLO churn. We should define a migration path and a default fallback to avoid outages.

mike (Arch): Draft policy example (for discussion):
```yaml
routing_tiers:
  - name: reserved
    isolation: hard
    regions: [us-west-2, eu-west-1]
    capacity_model: reserved
  - name: shared-priority
    isolation: soft
    regions: [us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1]
    capacity_model: burst
  - name: best-effort
    isolation: none
    regions: [any]
    capacity_model: opportunistic
```

mike (Arch): Key here is a config API so product teams can pin per-route without infra churn.

anna (Product): Launch criteria suggestion: 1) policy schema stable, 2) control-plane UI + API, 3) SRE runbook and automated fallback, 4) one enterprise pilot + one mid-market pilot.

sam (SRE): Add measurable SLOs: <95th latency increase threshold>, per-tier error budget, and automated throttles. Also require chaos test that flips region pins.

julia (Customer Success): For pilots, we need a simple opt-in flow and docs for customers to request region pins. I'll draft a template contract clause for EU-only routing.

anna (Product): Prioritization: MVP = control-plane + reserved tier + automated fallback. Post-MVP = UI polish, policy language extensions (e.g., hardware prefs), cost visibility per-tier.

mike (Arch): Dependency list: routing policy store, scheduler tagging, KV-cache affinity changes, and traffic shaping hooks. Estimated cross-team effort: 6–8 sprints if parallelized.

sam (SRE): Risk register items: misrouted traffic, degraded bulk throughput, complexity of migrations. Mitigations: canary routing, traffic shadowing, circuit-breakers per-tenant.

anna (Product): Action items: mike to produce final schema + migration playbook by next Wed; sam to prototype canary script; julia to line up two pilot customers. I'll own rollout criteria and roadmap slot.

deploy-bot: new doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/routing/2045678910-draft-policy-spec (link placeholder) :white_check_mark:

mike (Arch): Noted. I'll put the schema PR and a short demo in the deck for the roadmap review.

anna (Product): Great. We'll review on Friday's architecture sync. TL;DR: focus MVP on reserved + fallback and a lightweight API for pinning.

sam (SRE): +1 — will add runbook template to the doc.

julia (Customer Success): I'll prep customer comms and a pilot checklist.

anna (Product): Thanks all — moving this to the roadmap board and tagging owners.
